extra_quotes: By viewing magnons as the system and the other three quasiparticles as a quantum many-body bath, we derive an extended Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (eLLG) equation.

Note that σ can be interpreted as the spread of phonon modes around k = 0, so we restrict it to a small value σ = 1 meV to correspond to excitons with small momentum that are typically excited by fsLP.
For the exciton sector, we consider only the B and D excitons within XB manifold of CrSBr at energy ≃ 1.8 eV [47].
